notes: Job Agent 3.0.2 beta improves the user-tested Gmail readonly reply review. Candidate messages now show full vacancy title and employer instead of technical job IDs, with a cleaner three-column layout, plain-text snippet preview and conservative advisory categories distinguishing automatic receipt acknowledgments from possible interviews, possible rejections and other selection results. Generic selection-result subjects are never treated as confirmed rejections. New Отметить этап вручную action opens the existing explicit human-approved response editor only for verified submitted jobs; no automatic recruiter stage changes or Gmail writes. The Gmail API remains limited to user-initiated readonly scans of metadata and snippets; no automatic sending, CV upload or background polling. Release tooling now preserves source/gmail_responses.py and source/GMAIL_SETUP.md and fails if imported Gmail modules would be lost from persisted sanitized source. Regression suite: 101/101 passing on GitHub Actions; native macOS build and real user acceptance still need separate verification.
